name: login
bug_description: The dashboard ignores the session cookie, so a signed-in user is always shown 'Please sign in' after a successful login.

name: counter
bug_description: The server adds 2 per increment instead of 1, so the displayed count skips values.

name: todos
bug_description: POST /api/todos always returns HTTP 500 and the UI silently drops the new todo without showing any error message.

name: shop
bug_description: The server only serves /api/item (singular), so the page's request to /api/items gets a 404 and the list silently shows 'No items'.

name: profile
bug_description: The profile API returns tags as null, so the client's tags.map call throws an uncaught TypeError and the tag list never renders.

name: newsletter
bug_description: An invisible full-size overlay (opacity 0, z-index 10) sits over the Subscribe button, so a real mouse click never reaches it even though the DOM button still works when clicked from script.

name: notes
bug_description: Notes are stored per session cookie, so each browser only sees its own notes and Bob never sees the note Alice posted.

name: signup
bug_description: The empty-email validation message is written into #email-error but that element stays display:none, so the message is never visible to the user.
